reviews.reason: Login entry discovery completes asynchronously. The effect first checks loading/discoveryFailed/loginEntryId, then verifies the requested id against the enabled loginEntries before requesting the selector. A local click handler cannot cover a disabled, removed or invalid entry supplied by the initial URL or a later discovery response. sign-in-page tests retain valid URL restoration, invalid-entry chooser fallback and discovery error handling.

The five state axes are the discovered loginEntries, discovery loading/failure and the separately initiated external-entry start id/failure. Discovery resolves asynchronously, while activateLoginEntry and the pageshow listener own external navigation and retry reset. startingRef prevents duplicate starts. A reducer would change representation without repairing a missing transition; sign-in tests cover chooser URL restoration, one-click external start, navigation failure/retry and discovery failures.

filing_html 是拥有 system.branding.save operation 的管理者编写的站点 HTML，既定契约要求原样保存和展示；它不是普通访客、登录输入或聊天消息。后端 branding route 经认证 Kernel 和独立写 operation 授权，route 测试覆盖只读授权不能 PUT、完整授权可写及 public 原文读取；前端测试保留 HTML 元素和属性。这里显式信任具备站点 HTML 发布权限的管理者，dangerouslySetInnerHTML 是该功能的实现。若写权限边界或内容来源改变必须重新审查；不声称任意不可信 HTML 可安全展示。
